 ABOUT THE HUB Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards. 
 ROLE PURPOSE You are the hub's performance and improvement engine. You will build the Intelligent Command Centre that gives leaders one real-time view of service health across every tower. You will also run the continuous improvement system that moves the hub from stable operations to best-in-class service.

Capture and certify the pre-transition baselines for each country, so the hub can prove its value against the starting point. Support the transition PMO with readiness scorecards, go/no-go dashboards and hypercare tracking for every wave. Set up the Intelligent Command Centre, covering architecture, data pipelines, dashboards and alerting. 2. Process ownership and service delivery Run the ICC day to day, with real-time SLA, volume, backlog and escalation monitoring across R2P, R2H, Q2R and A2W. Lead the hub's governance rhythm: daily stand-ups, weekly tower reviews, monthly service reviews and quarterly business reviews with stakeholders. Own the hub-wide customer voice programme, including CSAT and NPS surveys, closing the loop with respondents, and reporting insight. Run hub-level capacity and productivity analytics to support resourcing decisions. 3. Governance, risk and controls Own the hub quality management system, covering process documentation standards, internal quality audits and control testing across towers. Maintain the hub risk register and the tracking of issues and actions. Build data governance for performance reporting so that there is one version of the truth. 4. Continuous improvement and digital Build and govern the hub-wide continuous improvement backlog. Prioritise by value and effort, and agree ownership with each GPO. Lead improvement projects using Lean, Six Sigma and process mining. Track benefits through to realised savings. Run the hub's automation and AI pipeline, from idea intake to business case, delivery and benefits tracking. Build a continuous improvement culture through training, recognition and a simple way for every employee to raise ideas. 5. People leadership, performance and culture Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave. Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state. Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings. Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots. Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day. Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers. 
 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE First 90 days: hub KPI framework, baseline method and ICC design signed off. By go-live: ICC live with real-time dashboards for the first transition wave, and the governance rhythm running. Within 1218 months: continuous improvement portfolio delivering measurable, validated benefits, with hub-wide dashboards trusted by global stakeholders.

They will be finalised in the hub SLA framework and country baselines.

Data analytics and visualisation (Power BI or Tableau). SQL or data-modelling skills are an advantage. Process mining (Celonis, Signavio or similar) and automation pipeline management (RPA, AI). ITIL service level management and quality management systems. Benefits realisation and business case development.

Has built and run an ICC, command centre or equivalent governance function. Has deployed continuous improvement frameworks across multi-tower shared services centres. Lean Six Sigma Black Belt. Master's degree in Business, HR, Engineering or a related field. Preferred Transition PMO experience Process mining certification Change management certification (Prosci or equivalent)

Job Description Customer Support Executive 
 Company: Refit Global Pvt. Ltd.
 Location: D Block, Sector 63, Noida, Uttar Pradesh
 Job Type: Full-Time, Onsite
 Experience: 1-3 Years
 Department: Customer Support / D2C Operations
 Working Days: 6 Days a Week
 Profile: Customer Support Executive 
 About the Role 
 Refit Global Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a Customer Support Executive with 13 years of experience to manage customer queries, D2C order processing, order fulfilment, logistics coordination, and related reporting activities. The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, good attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple orders and customer queries efficiently in a fast-paced environment. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. D2C Order Management & Reporting Prepare First Half and Second Half sales reports . Maintain daily pending order sheets and ensure timely follow-ups. Prepare accurate final consolidated sales and order reports. Verify order-related data and maintain accuracy in reporting. 
 2. Order Processing & Fulfilment Handle billing and invoice generation for customer orders. Coordinate with logistics partners for timely order fulfilment. Manage self-pickup and Porter deliveries . Process and update order information on Shopify . Coordinate internally to resolve order fulfilment issues. 
 3. Customer Support & Query Resolution Handle customer queries through KwikEngage chat . Manage Knowlarity inbound and missed calls . Resolve customer concerns primarily related to delivery, logistics, order status, and fulfilment. Provide timely and professional responses to customers. Coordinate with relevant teams to resolve customer issues. 
 4. Order Monitoring & Cancellation Regularly monitor order status from order placement to fulfilment. Identify orders delayed due to logistics or operational issues. Process order cancellations due to stock unavailability or non-serviceable pincodes . Ensure customers are appropriately informed about cancellations and order updates. Maintain proper records of cancelled and pending orders. 
 5. Data Management & Communication Maintain daily call reports and customer interaction records. Update customer address changes accurately in Shopify. Send email communication for order confirmations, cancellations, and relevant updates . Maintain proper documentation of customer and order-related information. Ensure accurate and timely data entry across systems. 
 Required Skills 
 13 years of experience in Customer Support, Customer Service, D2C Operations, E-commerce Operations, or Order Management . Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Good knowledge of MS Excel/Google Sheets . Basic understanding of Shopify or other e-commerce platforms. Experience with customer support/chat platforms is preferred. Ability to handle calls, chats, emails, and operational tasks simultaneously. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Good problem-solving and coordination skills. Ability to work under pressure and meet daily operational targets. Comfortable working in an onsite, 6-day working environment . 
 Preferred Experience 
 Candidates with experience in: D2C / E-commerce operations Order processing and fulfilment Logistics coordination Shopify order management Customer support Chat and voice support Sales/order reporting

 ROLE SUMMARY 
 Parnami Logistics is seeking an experienced and hands-on Traffic Manager to lead PAN India transportation and fleet 
 operations. This role goes beyond day-to-day dispatch you will own vehicle placement and deployment across 
 owned, attached, and market fleets, build a strong transporter network, and drive fleet utilization, cost control, and on- 
 time delivery across a mixed commercial fleet.

 Work Schedule 
 Experience Required

 5+ Years 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Manage PAN India transportation & fleet operations across own, attached, and market vehicles. 
 Plan and arrange vehicle placement & deployment as per load, volume, route and customer requirement. 
 ¢ Handle placement and deployment of different types of vehicles. 
 ¢ Monitor vehicle availability and ensure timely reporting. 
 ¢ Maximize vehicle utilization and fleet productivity. 
 ¢ Coordinate with transporters, fleet owners, drivers, and internal operations teams. 
 ¢ Build and maintain a strong market transporter/vendor network; negotiate transportation rates. 
 ¢ Plan vehicle allocation and route deployment; monitor vehicle movement from placement to delivery. 
 ¢ Monitor transportation cost and identify opportunities for cost optimization. 
 ¢ Maintain daily vehicle placement and transportation MIS. 
 ¢ Monitor transporter performance and resolve operational issues. 
 ¢ Coordinate with warehouses, customers, and dispatch teams to ensure timely placement, loading, dispatch and 
 delivery. 
 ¢ Handle transportation escalations and implement transportation SOPs with operational discipline. 
 VEHICLE CATEGORIES 
 ¢ Single-Axle Trucks, 10 / 12 / 14-Wheelers. 
 ¢ Closed Body & Open Body Vehicles. 
 ¢ LCV / MCV Tata 407 and similar vehicles; Tata Ace / Small to 32 fleet. 
 ¢ Reefer / Temperature-Controlled Vehicles and other specialized vehicles as required. 
 Note: Experience with every category above is not mandatory strong experience managing multiple vehicle types and mixed fleets is 
 preferred. 
 ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS 
 ¢ Minimum 5+ years of experience in Transportation / Fleet / Traffic Management, with PAN India exposure preferred. 
 ¢ Hands-on experience managing own fleet plus attached/market fleet. 
 ¢ Strong experience in vehicle placement, deployment, and transporter/vendor management. 
 ¢ Good understanding of vehicle utilization, fleet productivity, and route planning. 
 ¢ Ability to handle high-volume transportation requirements with strong operational coordination. 
 ¢ Good working knowledge of MS Excel and transportation MIS. 
 
 
 ¢ Preferred background: 3PL, FMCG logistics, distribution, supply chain, or large regional transport companies. 
 ¢ Stable employment history preferred. 
 ¢ Frequent job changer will not consider. 
 ABOUT PARNAMI LOGISTICS 
 Parnami Logistics is North India's leading C&F Agent and 3PL player, with a strong presence across Rajasthan, Delhi, 
 Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, and Uttarakhand. The company offers end-to-end warehousing, transportation, distribution, 
 and freight-forwarding solutions, backed by a 200+ strong fleet, 45 dedicated warehouses spanning 15 lakh+ sq. ft. of 
 space, and 250+ skilled manpower, executing 10,000+ trips per month with round-the-clock support. 
 Parnami Logistics serves marquee clients including Amazon, Jio, P&G, Godrej, Dabur, Reliance Industries, Amul, 
 Whirlpool, Asian Paints, Amway, Johnson & Johnson, and Xpressbees, among others.
